# Logitech

> Logitech is a global computer peripherals company offering premium input devices, audio equipment, and workplace solutions for consumers, businesses, and educators.

Logitech's product ecosystem spans mice, keyboards, webcams, headsets, and accessories across consumer, business, and gaming segments. The company serves diverse use cases from hybrid work and education to creative professionals and gamers, with flagship products like the MX Master 4 and MX Keys S.

## Key Topics

- MX Master 4
- MX Keys S
- MX Brio
- Wireless connectivity
- Bluetooth
- USB-C
- Gaming peripherals
- Business solutions
- Hybrid work
- iPad accessories
- Ergonomic design
- LIGHTSYNC RGB
- Refurbished products
- Education technology
- 4K webcams

## Shop & Product Catalog

- [Products - Logitech](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop): Main product catalog with mice, keyboards, webcams, headsets and accessories
- [Computer Mice - Wireless Mouse, Bluetooth, Wired | Logitech](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/mice): Wireless and wired mice including MX Master 4, Lift and ergonomic options
- [Computer Keyboards - Wireless, Bluetooth, Mechanical | Logitech](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/keyboards): Keyboards including mechanical, wireless and ergonomic Alto Keys and MX models
- [Keyboard and Mouse Combos | Logitech United States](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/combos): Bundled keyboard and mouse combos like MX Keys S and Wave Keys Lift
- [Webcams - 4K, Full HD, 1080p | Logitech](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/webcams): 4K and HD webcams including MX Brio for video conferencing and streaming
- [Headsets - Wireless, USB, Bluetooth | Logitech](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/headsets): Wireless and USB headsets including Zone series and noise-cancelling options
- [Logitech Best Sellers - Mice, Keyboards, Webcams, and Headsets](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/best-sellers): Best-selling products including MX Master 4, MX Keys S and Wave Keys

## Specialized Products

- [Logitech iPad Keyboards](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/ipad-keyboards): iPad keyboard cases for iPad Pro, Air, Mini and standard iPad models
- [Microphones | Logitech G](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/microphones): Gaming and streaming microphones including YETI ORB and premium audio gear
- [Speakers - Bluetooth, Wireless & Surround Sound | Logitech United States](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/speakers): Bluetooth and wireless speakers including WONDERBOOM 4 and portable audio
- [Digital Pens -  Enhance Your Creativity and Productivity | Logitech](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/digital-pens): Digital styluses including MX Ink for iPad and spatial computing devices
- [Presenters - Wireless Presenters & Laser Pointers | Logitech United States](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/presenters): Wireless presentation remotes and laser pointers for professional presentations
- [Gaming Mouse Pads, Gaming Mouse Mats | Logitech G United States](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/gaming-mouse-pads): Gaming mouse pads including POWERPLAY 2 with wireless charging technology
- [Gaming Gear Accessories | Logitech G](https://www.logitech.com/en-us/shop/c/accessories): Gaming accessories including palm rests, USB receivers and keyboard sleeves
